meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 就能通过 Webex 聊天收发消息:技能会复制 Webex 适配器、注册它、安装依赖,并把机器人令牌和回调密钥写入配置,启动回调服务。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Webex 渠道,或走到 /setup、/manage-channels 这类渠道配置流程时,技能开始执行。

say.text: 把 Webex 渠道接入 Claude。
say.note: 技能会复制适配器、注册渠道并安装依赖。

say.text: 帮我配置 Webex 机器人。
say.note: 它会提示粘贴机器人令牌和回调密钥。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Webex 支持。
say.note: 执行完可继续用 /manage-channels 绑定群组。

howto.what_en: Claude can then send/receive messages via Webex. The skill copies the Webex adapter, registers it, installs the pinned package, prompts for bot token and webhook secret, writes them to .env, and starts a webhook server.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Webex support or during channel setup flows such as /setup or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel to Claude.
say_en.note: It copies the adapter, registers the channel, and installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Set up a Webex bot for me.
say_en.note: It will ask for the bot token and webhook secret.
Then use /manage-channels to bind it to an agent group.
